test_overview:
Regression smoke test of core MVP flows (booking -> job -> invoice) on the ComfortPro Connect HVAC app. All 4 steps passed fully. The Job Rescheduling feature did NOT break base functionality.

Step 1 (test_client_signup_and_booking): Signed up Client Olivia Nguyen; auto-signed-in; dashboard shows Properties/Bookings/Jobs/Invoices; created HVAC/Residential/Repair/Standard booking (today+14=2026-08-22, PM, "Furnace not heating."); confirmation view "Service Request Submitted!" with Booking ID #1; booking discoverable in client Bookings area. PASS (8/8).

Step 2 (test_technician_converts_booking_to_job): Signed out; registered Technician Noah Patel (auto-signin); tech dashboard shows Bookings/Jobs/Invoices (no Properties); located Olivia's booking; converted to Job with schedule 2026-08-22/PM; Job #1 created, status Scheduled, accessible in Noah's Jobs area, assigned to Noah; original booking no longer actionable New. PASS (8/8).

Step 3 (test_job_status_progression): UI never offered direct Scheduled->Completed (treated as passing per plan). Transitioned Scheduled->In Progress. Attempted Complete without notes: blocked with "At least one note is required before completing the job", status stayed In Progress. Added note "Restored heat; replaced ignitor." then changed to Completed; status Completed; note visible on job detail. PASS (12/12).

Step 4 (test_invoice_visibility_rules): Created invoice 275.00 due 2026-09-07 as Draft; Draft visible to technician with status Draft; client did NOT see Draft (Draft tech-only); technician sent invoice Draft->Sent; client then saw Sent invoice with correct amount $275.00 and due date Sep 7, 2026; client invoice detail was read-only with no edit/status-change controls. PASS (12/12).

Total: 40/40.

steps.description: test_client_signup_and_booking: Signed up as Client Olivia Nguyen; user signed in automatically; dashboard shows Client sections (Properties, Bookings, Jobs, Invoices). Created booking (HVAC/Residential/Repair/Standard, phone 3125550123, 500 W Madison St, Chicago, IL 60661, date 2026-08-22, PM, 'Furnace not heating.') with autofilled read-only name/email. Booking submitted with confirmation 'Service Request Submitted!'; Booking ID #1 displayed; booking discoverable in client Bookings area via 'View My Bookings'. All verifications (incl. 3 non-fatal) passed.

test_technician_converts_booking_to_job: Signed out; registered Technician Noah Patel (auto-signin, fresh context); tech dashboard shows Bookings/Jobs/Invoices (no Properties). Located Olivia's Booking #1; converted to Job (2026-08-22/PM). Job #1 created, status Scheduled, accessible in Noah's Jobs area, Technician=Noah (manage gated to assigned tech); original booking no longer actionable New. All verifications (incl. 3 non-fatal) passed.

test_job_status_progression: Opened Job #1. From Scheduled, UI never offered direct Completed (treated as passing per plan). Scheduled->In Progress verified. Complete without notes blocked (error 'At least one note is required before completing the job', status stayed In Progress). Added note 'Restored heat; replaced ignitor.' then In Progress->Completed verified. Note visible on job detail. All verifications (incl. 2 non-fatal) passed.

test_invoice_visibility_rules: From Completed job, created Invoice #1 amount 275.00 due 2026-09-07 as Draft. Draft visible to technician (status Draft). Client did NOT see Draft (Draft tech-only). Technician sent invoice (Draft->Sent via Send to Client + Confirm). Refreshed client Invoices: Olivia now sees Sent invoice with amount $275.00 and due date Sep 7, 2026. Client invoice detail read-only (no Edit/Send/Mark Paid/Void/status-change controls). All verifications (incl. 3 non-fatal) passed.
